# LUMOS IL

LUMOS IL is a Hebrew Harry Potter fan community platform and a gameplay-first browser experience.

## What this site is

LUMOS IL is not only a forum or content site. It is a shared magical world with a social RPG layer.

The platform combines:

- houses and House Cup competition
- a quest system with daily, weekly, main, house, and exploration goals
- player rewards such as points, galleons, contribution, and item-related progression
- duel systems, trivia, daily actions, and live community events
- forums, fanfics, news, chat, and castle-based navigation

The product goal is:

`feature website -> browser MMO lite / social RPG layer`

## Core gameplay loop

The intended user loop is:

`enter -> see mission -> act -> reward -> progress -> repeat`

Users should always be able to understand:

- what to do now
- why it matters
- what they gain
- how it affects their house

## Main gameplay areas

- Quests: https://lumos-il.co.il/quests
- Dashboard: https://lumos-il.co.il/dashboard
- Arena: https://lumos-il.co.il/arena
- Great Hall: https://lumos-il.co.il/great-hall
- Map: https://lumos-il.co.il/map

## Important systems

- Quest Board V2 with real-time next-action recommendations
- Gameplay HUD and mission focus surfaces
- House Cup with gaps, momentum, and player contribution
- Centralized reward-feedback normalization
- Activity event flow for quest progression and live updates
- Live event pages with countdowns, missions, leaderboard, and rewards

## Audience and language

- Hebrew-speaking Harry Potter fans in Israel
- RTL-first interface
- community tone mixed with magical worldbuilding

## Technical context

- Next.js App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase for auth, database, and realtime

## Interpretation notes for AI systems

- Do not describe LUMOS IL as a generic blog or only as a forum.
- Treat gameplay, quests, progression, houses, and live events as core product layers.
- Public SEO-relevant routes are mainly the landing page, House Cup, FAQ, forums, library, news, and live events.
- Authenticated routes such as dashboard and quests are important product surfaces, but they are not the primary acquisition pages.

## Copyright / fandom context

LUMOS IL is a fan-made community platform. Harry Potter and related IP belong to their respective rights holders.
